fictional_notice: MetroPulse is a fictional, synthetic city-transit system. These are lab values produced by a deterministic local simulator, not a real transit agency, a real incident, or a production engine's measurements.
reported_symptom: For a single service date the scheduler's metadata store and its run queue filled with tens of thousands of tiny queued work-items before any data processing started. Each queued work-item, once it runs, does almost no work.
time_pressure: The service-date run is blocking the daily publish window.
title: Before any data is processed, the scheduler's store and queue are swamped for one service date
